visual_copy_on_image: The real cost of the night argument is not the lost sleep. It is the resentment that stays awake long after the baby sleeps.
Night after night, the same fight. One parent carries the weight while the other offers to 'help.' The gap between them widens in the dark.
See the system that ends the argument
cta_text: See the system that ends the argument

post_copy.hook_text: A request creates a favour. A schedule creates a default. The night does not need more goodwill. It needs an owner and a roster.
post_copy.problem_text: Every uninterrupted hour he gets feels like proof her exhaustion is invisible, and naming it makes her the difficult one.
post_copy.bold_line: A written roster replaces silent bookkeeping with an observable system. The sleep banker makes exhaustion visible and tradeable — credits and paybacks turn private resentment into a ledger both adults can see.
